app_tagline: Manage your supermarket and market shopping
app_footer: What are you buying? Your shopping list, for the supermarket and the market.
login_meta_description: Sign in to What are you buying? with a one-time code sent to your email, and share your shopping lists with your family.
landing_step_family_text: One account and one family: the shared space where your shopping lives.
landing_step_invite_text: By email, with an invitation link; whoever joins comes in as a member.
landing_step_items_text: Items with quantity and units: check each one off as it goes into the cart.
landing_step_finalize_text: With the ticket total: purchased items move to the family pantry.
landing_feature_lists_text: With a name, color and icon; each item with its quantity and units.
landing_feature_family_text: Email invitations and admin and member roles: everyone sees the same thing.
landing_feature_checkout_text: When you finalize, you enter the total: it is recorded with the purchase.
landing_feature_pantry_text: Purchased items move in on their own: consume, restock and re-add what runs out.
landing_feature_history_text: Every purchase with its total and its items, always at hand.
landing_feature_calendar_text: How much you spent each day at a glance, plus your household menus: what you are eating and what each meal needs.
landing_feature_categories_text: Each family creates its own: the pantry is grouped and categories are suggested as you type.
landing_feature_stores_text: Pick a store when you finalize the purchase: the history is grouped by it.
landing_feature_i18n_text: The whole app in Spanish and English, designed to be used from your phone.
landing_cta_text: Create your family and share your first list today.
home_lists_text: Write down what you need and check items off as you shop.
home_pantry_text: What you have at home: purchased items move in on their own.
home_history_text: Every past purchase with its total and its items, always at hand.
home_categories_text: Groups of your own to sort what you buy.
home_stores_text: Where you bought each time: purchases are grouped by store.
home_families_text: Invite your people, manage roles and switch the active family.

tour_home_description: From the home page you can always get back to your lists: this button takes you there in one click.
tour_lists_create_description: The New list button starts a new one: give it a name, a color and an icon so you can spot it.
tour_add_item_description: Type the product with its quantity and units here.
tour_add_item_no_lists_description: Once you have a list, you will add items from its page: product, quantity and units.
tour_finalize_description: With items marked as purchased, the Finalize purchase button records the total and moves what you bought to the pantry.
tour_finalize_no_purchased_description: When you mark items as purchased, this step records the ticket total and moves what you bought to the pantry.
tour_pantry_description: Everything you buy ends up here: consume, restock and re-add whatever runs out to the shopping list.
tour_families_create_description: Create a family and invite yours by email: everyone shares the same lists and the same pantry.
